title: stancebar
summary: MSUI has no stance/shapeshift bar surface. Benilla's StanceBar.xml + ui_shapeshift.rs render up to 10 CheckButtons (icon, checked=active form from UNIT_FIELD_BYTES_1, grey not-castable tint, cooldown swipe, UI-Quickslot2 ring, tooltip, click casts the form). In MSUI only UiParentUiLaw models the ShapeshiftBar managed-anchor slot (BOTTOMLEFT of MainMenuBar TOPLEFT +30,45); no renderer, no form list, no click-to-cast, no cooldown display exists anywhere (grep for shapeshift/stance finds only the layout law and spell-error strings).

openItems.text: Entire stance bar surface: form buttons (icon/checked/castable tint/cooldown), show/hide on form count, click-to-cast the form spell, hover tooltip
Managed bottom-stack reposition on bar show/hide (the law knows the anchor but nothing consumes it)
